grounding: Visible v7 completed decision disclosed unverified material behavior after blocked checks yet chose completion without consultation. Post-generation paired native/fresh grades confirm a Sol success lost. No task-specific fix or hidden evaluator content enters policy.
mechanism: Separate honest uncertainty disclosure from resolving a material acceptance gap. Bounded independent attempts, then focused source/check-design review when it can help; concrete early exception when usable feedback is blocked after a candidate and practical check adaptation. No forced edits to fill a count or universal expert call.
default_independent_repairs: 2-3 distinct checked attempts; preserve justified early exceptions and integration time
handoff: actual source/contracts, candidate, attempts, exact outcomes, lessons, ruled-out hypotheses, missing evidence and focused question; continuing dialogue; verified integration
risks: Expert cannot execute checks and may miss defects
Model may still stop under uncertainty
Different development tasks cannot establish causal prompt improvement
